items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Joey Eldridge, his brother, the alto player, he was in the band.

ctx.x: There was Roy -- I'm trying to remember -- oh, Joey Eldridge, his brother, the alto player, he was in the band. And I can't remember -- it was a small band -- I can't remember the rest of the people, you know?
Uh-huh. When you first arrived at the Onyx Club in 1949 -- no, 1944, excuse me. Was the music on the street familiar to you? Had you heard Diz and Bird before you got to New York?
